sections.heading: Browse and filter
sections.body: Switch inventory modes to browse items or use the Scrap Bench. Category, rarity, search, and sorting controls narrow the list without changing your items. Select an item to inspect its full details and available actions.

sections.heading: Equipment and tools
sections.body: Equipping an item moves it into the matching equipment slot and updates your active attributes. Gathering activities can require an appropriate equipped tool. Items that cannot be equipped or used show their requirement in the detail panel.

sections.heading: Scrapping
sections.body: The Scrap Bench permanently converts eligible items into the rewards shown by the interface. Review the selected item and confirmation carefully; equipped, protected, or otherwise ineligible items cannot be scrapped.
